subject.title: Subagent lifecycle observability + async supervision controls

question: Which core contract should own durable subagent lifecycle receipts and audited cancel/steer/resume supervision: the task ledger, audit ledger, artifact/session-control primitives, or a dedicated lifecycle API?
rationale: The source shows partial task summaries and internal controls, but the requested public lifecycle and supervision surface crosses protocol, persistence, authorization, redaction, retention, and audit boundaries that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Extend existing primitives
options.body: Use the task ledger for ordered lifecycle receipts, audit records for supervision mutations, and artifact/session-control links for payloads and follow-up actions.

options.title: Create a dedicated lifecycle API
options.body: Add a separate protocol and persistence surface only if existing task/audit/artifact primitives cannot express the ordered receipt and supervision model cleanly.

options.title: Defer broad supervision controls
options.body: Keep only summary/cancel behavior for now and leave steer/resume/timeline receipts to narrower follow-up issues.

recommendation.title: Extend existing primitives
recommendation.body: Use the task ledger for ordered lifecycle receipts, audit records for supervision mutations, and artifact/session-control links for payloads and follow-up actions.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision spans product shape and subagent/task lifecycle boundaries, and steipete is the strongest available routing signal from related area ownership.
